caption: The drawing is composed of two black ink outlined technical illustrations on a light beige background. The left illustration depicts a front view of a rectangular wooden structure, possibly a door or a section of paneling, featuring a central set of double doors with horizontal and vertical framing elements. The structure includes ornamental vertical strips with curved details on both sides of the central doors. Horizontal rectangular panels fill the spaces above and below the doors, while the vertical edges are framed with straight lines. The right illustration shows a side or sectional view of the same structure, with three horizontal rectangular panels joined by vertical framing members. Both illustrations are precisely lined, and in the bottom right corner, there is handwritten text in black ink noting the scale, the type of drawing ("Jack Workbench"), and a signature or attribution. The paper has some visible age marks and slight foxing.
title: Cupboard
